comment:
* Reports power consumption values for various device activities. Reads values from an XML file.
 * Customize the XML file for different devices.
 * [hidden]

variables.name: POWER_CPU_SUSPEND
variables.comment:
* POWER_CPU_SUSPEND: Power consumption when CPU is in power collapse mode.
     * POWER_CPU_IDLE: Power consumption when CPU is awake (when a wake lock is held). This should
     *                 be zero on devices that can go into full CPU power collapse even when a wake
     *                 lock is held. Otherwise, this is the power consumption in addition to
     * POWER_CPU_SUSPEND due to a wake lock being held but with no CPU activity.
     * POWER_CPU_ACTIVE: Power consumption when CPU is running, excluding power consumed by clusters
     *                   and cores.
     *
     * CPU Power Equation (assume two clusters):
     * Total power = POWER_CPU_SUSPEND  (always added)
     *               + POWER_CPU_IDLE   (skip this and below if in power collapse mode)
     *               + POWER_CPU_ACTIVE (skip this and below if CPU is not running, but a wakelock
     *                                   is held)
     *               + cluster_power.cluster0 + cluster_power.cluster1 (skip cluster not running)
     *               + core_power.cluster0 * num running cores in cluster 0
     *               + core_power.cluster1 * num running cores in cluster 1

variables.name: POWER_WIFI_SCAN
variables.comment: * Power consumption when WiFi driver is scanning for networks.

variables.name: POWER_WIFI_ON
variables.comment: * Power consumption when WiFi driver is on.

variables.name: POWER_WIFI_ACTIVE
variables.comment: * Power consumption when WiFi driver is transmitting/receiving.

variables.name: POWER_GPS_ON
variables.comment: * Power consumption when GPS is on.

variables.name: POWER_GPS_SIGNAL_QUALITY_BASED
variables.comment: * GPS power parameters based on signal quality

variables.name: POWER_BLUETOOTH_ON
variables.comment:
* Power consumption when Bluetooth driver is on.
     *
     * @deprecated

variables.name: POWER_BLUETOOTH_ACTIVE
variables.comment:
* Power consumption when Bluetooth driver is transmitting/receiving.
     *
     * @deprecated

variables.name: POWER_BLUETOOTH_AT_CMD
variables.comment:
* Power consumption when Bluetooth driver gets an AT command.
     *
     * @deprecated

variables.name: POWER_AMBIENT_DISPLAY
variables.comment:
* Power consumption when screen is in doze/ambient/always-on mode, including backlight power.
     *
     * @deprecated Use {@link #POWER_GROUP_DISPLAY_AMBIENT} instead.

variables.name: POWER_SCREEN_ON
variables.comment:
* Power consumption when screen is on, not including the backlight power.
     *
     * @deprecated Use {@link #POWER_GROUP_DISPLAY_SCREEN_ON} instead.

variables.name: POWER_RADIO_ON
variables.comment: * Power consumption when cell radio is on but not on a call.

variables.name: POWER_RADIO_SCANNING
variables.comment: * Power consumption when cell radio is hunting for a signal.

variables.name: POWER_RADIO_ACTIVE
variables.comment: * Power consumption when talking on the phone.

variables.name: POWER_SCREEN_FULL
variables.comment:
* Power consumption at full backlight brightness. If the backlight is at
     * 50% brightness, then this should be multiplied by 0.5
     *
     * @deprecated Use {@link #POWER_GROUP_DISPLAY_SCREEN_FULL} instead.

variables.name: POWER_AUDIO
variables.comment:
* Power consumed by the audio hardware when playing back audio content. This is in addition
     * to the CPU power, probably due to a DSP and / or amplifier.

variables.name: POWER_VIDEO
variables.comment:
* Power consumed by any media hardware when playing back video content. This is in addition
     * to the CPU power, probably due to a DSP.

variables.name: POWER_FLASHLIGHT
variables.comment: * Average power consumption when camera flashlight is on.

variables.name: POWER_MEMORY
variables.comment: * Power consumption when DDR is being used.

variables.name: POWER_CAMERA
variables.comment:
* Average power consumption when the camera is on over all standard use cases.
     *
     * TODO: Add more fine-grained camera power metrics.

variables.name: POWER_WIFI_BATCHED_SCAN
variables.comment:
* Power consumed by wif batched scaning.  Broken down into bins by
     * Channels Scanned per Hour.  May do 1-720 scans per hour of 1-100 channels
     * for a range of 1-72,000.  Going logrithmic (1-8, 9-64, 65-512, 513-4096, 4097-)!

variables.name: POWER_BATTERY_CAPACITY
variables.comment: * Battery capacity in milliAmpHour (mAh).

variables.name: POWER_GROUP_DISPLAY_AMBIENT
variables.comment: * Power consumption when a screen is in doze/ambient/always-on mode, including backlight power.

variables.name: POWER_GROUP_DISPLAY_SCREEN_ON
variables.comment: * Power consumption when a screen is on, not including the backlight power.

variables.name: POWER_GROUP_DISPLAY_SCREEN_FULL
variables.comment: * Power consumption of a screen at full backlight brightness.

variables.name: SUBSYSTEM_MASK
variables.comment:
* Constants for generating a 64bit power constant key.
     *
     * The bitfields of a key describes what its corresponding power constant represents:
     * [63:40] - RESERVED
     * [39:32] - {@link Subsystem} (max count = 16).
     * [31:0] - per Subsystem fields, see {@link ModemPowerProfile}.
     *

variables.name: SUBSYSTEM_NONE
variables.comment: * Power constant not associated with a subsystem.

variables.name: SUBSYSTEM_MODEM
variables.comment: * Modem power constant.

variables.name: sPowerItemMap
variables.comment: * A map from Power Use Item to its power consumption.

variables.name: sPowerArrayMap
variables.comment:
* A map from Power Use Item to an array of its power consumption
     * (for items with variable power e.g. CPU).

methods.name: public double getAveragePowerOrDefault(String type, double defaultValue)
methods.comment:

     * default value if the subsystem has no recorded value.
     *

     * @param defaultValue the value to return if the subsystem has no recorded value.
     * @return the average current in milliAmps.

methods.name: public double getAverageBatteryDrainOrDefaultMa(long key, double defaultValue)
methods.comment:
* Returns the average current in mA consumed by a subsystem's specified operation, or the given
     * default value if the subsystem has no recorded value.
     *
     * @param key that describes a subsystem's battery draining operation
     *            The key is built from multiple constant, see {@link Subsystem} and
     *            {@link ModemPowerProfile}.
     * @param defaultValue the value to return if the subsystem has no recorded value.
     * @return the average current in milliAmps.

     *            {@link ModemPowerProfile}.
     * @return the average current in milliAmps.

methods.name: public double getAveragePower(String type, int level)
methods.comment:
* Returns the average current in mA consumed by the subsystem for the given level.
     *
     * @param type  the subsystem type
     * @param level the level of power at which the subsystem is running. For instance, the
     *              signal strength of the cell network between 0 and 4 (if there are 4 bars max.)
     *              If there is no data for multiple levels, the level is ignored.
     * @return the average current in milliAmps.

methods.name: public double getAveragePowerForOrdinal(@PowerGroup String group, int ordinal, double defaultValue)
methods.comment:
* Returns the average current in mA consumed by an ordinaled subsystem, or the given
     * default value if the subsystem has no recorded value.
     *
     * @param group        the subsystem {@link PowerGroup}.
     * @param ordinal      which entity in the {@link PowerGroup}.
     * @param defaultValue the value to return if the subsystem has no recorded value.
     * @return the average current in milliAmps.

methods.name: public double getAveragePowerForOrdinal(@PowerGroup String group, int ordinal)
methods.comment:
* Returns the average current in mA consumed by an ordinaled subsystem.
     *
     * @param group        the subsystem {@link PowerGroup}.
     * @param ordinal      which entity in the {@link PowerGroup}.
     * @return the average current in milliAmps.

methods.name: public double getBatteryCapacity()
methods.comment:
* Returns the battery capacity, if available, in milli Amp Hours. If not available,
     * it returns zero.
     *
     * @return the battery capacity in mAh
